{"id":1892893830,"question_id":3773,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months","timestamp":1769060230,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1892893830/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Pair Removal to Sort Array I","memory":"26.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumPairRemoval(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int oprs = 0;\n\n        if(is_sorted(nums.begin() , nums.end())) return 0;\n\n        while(!is_sorted(nums.begin() , nums.end()))\n        {\n            int n = nums.size();\n            int min_sum = INT_MAX;\n            int lowest_idx = -1;\n\n            for(int i = 0 ; i+1<n ; i++)\n            {\n                int pair_sum = nums[i] + nums[i+1];\n                if(pair_sum < min_sum)\n                {\n                    min_sum = pair_sum;\n                    lowest_idx = i;\n                }\n            }\n            nums[lowest_idx] = min_sum;\n            nums.erase(nums.begin() + (lowest_idx+1));\n            oprs++;\n\n            if(is_sorted(nums.begin() , nums.end())) break;\n        }\n        return oprs;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-pair-removal-to-sort-array-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1530}
